purpose: Assess Midas mobile/Atlas and official Midas-TradingView integration separately for strict G9 and provider-neutral ACCOUNT gates.

evidence: Midas officially advertises real-time U.S. market data free to its customers.

Midas support explicitly states TradingView market data is CBOE One while Midas has more comprehensive market-data licenses, proving the Midas app data path is distinct and broader than the TradingView path.
Midas publishes Nasdaq and NYSE subscriber/display agreements and acts as distributor/vendor for those agreements.

The Nasdaq subscriber agreement licenses non-professional/private subscriber information for personal use; no primary-source evidence found that grants the user's automated/non-display use required by strict G9-C.

The exact Midas mobile/Atlas product lineage has not yet been proven as consolidated UTP Tape-C/National NBBO, and the public Atlas query shapes reviewed expose last price/session state but no independent bid/ask event timestamps.
midas_mobile_atlas_market_data.reopen_condition: Primary-source Midas/venue documentation identifies exact consolidated National NBBO/UTP lineage and explicitly permits the intended automated/non-display personal use, plus a sanctioned scheduler-callable quote path returns fresh bid+ask+last with independent event timestamps.

evidence: Midas and TradingView officially support a broker integration; users can connect their Midas account from TradingView's Trading Panel.
Midas support states the TradingView market-data path is CBOE One, so this path cannot satisfy strict G9-A National NBBO.
TradingView broker integration architecture exposes account, balance/state, positions, orders and quotes surfaces, and account-manager views include balance/equity/positions.
Midas support states TradingView-connected users can view up to 200 past Midas orders, confirming real authenticated account-state integration.

TradingView states it does not provide an end-user data API; its REST Broker API is for brokers integrating into TradingView. No scheduler-callable end-user TradingView connector is currently available in this ChatGPT workspace.
midas_via_tradingview.account_reopen_condition: A sanctioned TradingView or Midas connector/API becomes callable by the canonical scheduler and same-run account value/cash plus equity positions/exposure can be read without order actions.

evidence: Public community project is explicitly unofficial and states Midas has no public API.
It drives the Atlas web app session and reproduces internal GraphQL reads.
Its read path exposes portfolio value, cash/buying power and positions, which is technically sufficient in shape for ACCOUNT.
Its current public quote/snapshot path reviewed exposes last trade price/session status and OHLCV candles but no bid/ask quote-event timestamps required for strict G9.
Because it is not an official/sanctioned Midas integration, it is not eligible as canonical ACCOUNT authority.
